Touya: "...Any sign of her?"
Yamato: "Hmm... It looks like she's not here."
Touya: "All right. Let's try somewhere else."
Melvi: "...Ooh... It's dark... Where am I...?
Is anybody there?"
Melvi: "...I'm starting to feel cold...
Ooh... S-Somebody... Big Brother..."
Melvi: "...The way out, the way out... Huh?
What's this box...?
Hmm... There are lots of them..."
Melvi: "Huh? This is canned food... Wow, there's so much!
...Oh! I get it. This is a storeroom.
Hmm... But I can't get out..."
Melvi: "Huh? This is canned food... Wow, there's so much!
...Oh! I get it. This is a storeroom.
Hmm... But I can't get out..."
Touya: "...Any sign of her?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Oh! I can sense her!
Here! She's in here!"
Touya: "All right!"
Yamato: "Whoa, it's dark! The automatic lights are broken...
W-What is this place? It's strangely cold...
Is the air conditioning broken too?"
Touya: "H-Hey, Melvi!"
Melvi: "...B-Big Brother...?"
Touya: "Yeah. All right, where's the light...?"
Melvi: "Big Brother!"
Touya: "...Honestly... Are you okay?"
Melvi: "Yeah! Big Brother!"
Touya: "Whoa! Okay, okay... Melvi, you're
cold all over."
Melvi: "...I'm so glad. Melvi was a little scared.
It was dark and cold in here..."
Touya: "Melvi..."
Melvi: "But I knew you'd find me,
Big Brother..."
Touya: "I see... But next time,
pick somewhere easier to find, okay?"
Melvi: "...Okay.
You're warm, Big Brother..."
Yamato: "Let's get out of here for now."
Touya: "Yeah."
Gen: "That's strange... Oh!"
Melvi: "Oh... Gen-chan."
Touya: "Hey. We found her."
Gen: "Thank goodness... Oh, so you were in the storeroom...
Don't make me worry like that!"
Melvi: "I'm sorry."
Gen: "Well, as long as you're safe.
...Aw, Big Brother beat me to it. Darn."
Yamato: "Gen..."
Gen: "Oh, well. It was a contest I couldn't win anyway.
I'll get going, then. Oh, right!
They said we're arriving soon! See you!"
Melvi: "Oh, Gen-chan..."
Touya: "...There we go."
Melvi: "Oh..."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "Melvi, you need to thank Gen properly."
Melvi: "Huh...?"
Touya: "If he hadn't told us you were missing, we couldn't have
found you so quickly."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "You've got to value your friends."
Melvi: "...Yeah. You're right."
Touya: "Go straight ahead and you'll reach the elevator.
Don't turn off to the side."
Melvi: "Okay. Thank you, Big Brother!"
Yamato: "Oh, so you've noticed how Gen feels too.
You've grown up a bit."
Touya: "...Huh? What are you talking about?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "Anyway, let's go to the bridge."
